searchText: Hi, I believe I have identified a potentially critical security vulnerability affecting Semaphore v4, with possible downstream impact on projects integrating it. I would like to disclose it responsibly and privately. Could a Semaphore/PSE security maintainer contact me or provide the appropriate secure disclosure channel? I will not share any technical details publicly. https://ethereum.org/bug-bounty/ Discord is not the place to disclose. Submit via the official Ethereum foundation bug bounty page. If it not in scope of the ef bug bounty, try their telegram channel in support subchannel. https://t.me/semaphore_community
